Description:en: Records the basis on which the certifying practitioner completed the medical certificate of cause of death.
Certifies that the practitioner attended the deceased before death.
Certifies that the practitioner examined the body after death.
Certifies that the practitioner conducted a post-mortem examination of the body and that the information provided is correct to the best of their knowledge.
Records the disease or condition directly leading to death.
Records the morbid condition that gave rise to the immediate cause of death.
Records the disease or condition that initiated the chain of events leading to death.

Fully specified name:en: OTHER SIGNIFICANT CONDITIONS CONTRIBUTING TO DEATH
Description:en: Records other significant conditions contributing to death but not part of the direct causal sequence.
